correctness: one full four-mode gate per revision, plus complete cross-revision identities/provenance and public-preflight equality
production_mode: public batch, parser-default graph policy, through report completion
callback_boundary: plain/noop/probe first construct complete producer projection, then unchanged authoritative full preflight; double-collection pilot, not authoritative inventory reuse
order: rotate revision order through all four positions; alternate two graph modes; rotate four callback conditions through all four positions
failure_policy: stop on parity, source/input drift or worker failure; preserve failing reports; no automatic timed retry
